A command declared inside the output package is harmless: the entry
builds only the command's dependency roots, never referencing the
declaring package, so no cycle exists.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.27

require github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli v0.1.0

replace github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli => CLIDIR
-- fabrik.yaml --
generate:
  emit: embedded
  dir: appwire
-- shared/db.go --
package shared

type DB struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() (*DB, error) { return &DB{}, nil }
-- appwire/cmd.go --
package appwire

import (
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"

	"app/shared"
)

//fabrik:cli:command
func Warm(ctx cli.Context, db *shared.DB) error { return nil }
-- want/fabrik.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package appwire

import (
	"context"

	"app/shared"
)

func NewWarm(ctx context.Context) (*shared.DB, error) {
	sharedDB, err := shared.NewDB()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return sharedDB, nil
}
